title: SSC MTS Full Length Mock Test 06 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC MTS. 90 Questions | 90 Minutes | Numerical 20, Reasoning 20, GA 25, English 25. 3 marks each.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 90 questions: Numerical Ability 20, Reasoning 20, General Awareness 25, English 25.
Har question 3 marks ka hai. Session-II pattern ke anusar galat jawab par 1 mark kat sakta hai.
Time: 90 minutes (Session-I 45 min + Session-II 45 min combined mock).
SSC MTS latest CBT pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Needle is to Sew as Pen is to ?
questions.explanation: A needle is used to sew and a pen is used to write.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.explanation: A doctor works in a hospital; a teacher works in a school.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing number: 5, 11, 24, 51, 106, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: Consecutive differences are +4, +6, +8, +10, +12. 30+12 = 42.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If COLD is coded as DPME, how is WARM coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is increased by 1: W→X, A→B, R→S, M→N.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If PAPER is written as QBQFS, how is PENCIL written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: P→Q, E→F, N→O, C→D, I→J, L→M.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a girl, a man said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to the man?
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son is the man's father. Father's daughter is the man's sister.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 10 km north, then 6 km east, then 10 km south. Distance from start?
questions.explanation: North and south cancel; net displacement is 6 km east.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: 121, 144, 169, 196, 225, 256, 288 — odd one?
questions.explanation: All others are perfect squares; 288 is not.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Mercury, Venus, Mars, Moon — odd one?
questions.explanation: Moon is a satellite; the others are planets.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: All pens are books. Some books are tables. Conclusions: I. Some pens are tables. II. Some books are pens.
questions.explanation: All pens are books implies some books are pens. I is not definite.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 11th from the left and B is 9th from the right. How many students are between A and B?
questions.explanation: Position of B from left = 40-9+1=32. Between = 32-11-1=20.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 1 January 2024 was a Monday, what day was 1 January 2025?
questions.explanation: 2024 is a leap year → +2 days. Monday + 2 = Wednesday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: The angle between the hands of a clock at 3:00 is?
questions.explanation: At 3:00 the hands are exactly at right angles, 90°.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15th August 2023 was a Tuesday, 15th August 2024 was a?
questions.explanation: 2024 leap year and 15 Aug is after Feb 29, so +2 weekdays: Tuesday→Thursday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.explanation: First letters A,B,C,D,E; second letters Z,Y,X,W,V.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A square paper is folded once in half and a hole is punched at a corner not on the fold. Unfolded holes?
questions.explanation: One fold doubles the punch → two holes.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All mangoes are fruits. Some fruits are red. Conclusion: Some mangoes are red.
questions.explanation: The red fruits need not include mangoes; conclusion is not definite.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which of the following cannot be formed using letters of the word EDUCATION?
questions.explanation: NATION needs two N; EDUCATION has only one N.

questions.explanation: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate.

questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.subject: English

questions.explanation: Brief means short in duration or length.

questions.subject: English

questions.explanation: Democracy is rule by the people.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is good _____ mathematics.
questions.explanation: The correct preposition is 'good at'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She has been living here _____ 2018.
questions.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point of time.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He go to school every day. Error is in?
questions.explanation: With 'He' the verb should be 'goes'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The sceneries of Kashmir are beautiful. Error?
questions.explanation: 'Scenery' is uncountable; do not use 'sceneries'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is senior than me.
questions.explanation: Senior/junior take the preposition 'to'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Passive of 'She writes a letter' is?
options: A letter is written by her
A letter was written by her
A letter is wrote by her
questions.explanation: Present simple active → is/are + V3.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He said, 'I am busy.' Indirect speech:
options: He said that he was busy.
He said that I am busy.
He said that he is busy.
He told that he was busy.
questions.explanation: Present changes to past in reported speech.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: Correct spelling is Accommodation (two c, two m).

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Correct spelling is?
questions.explanation: Embarrass has two r and two s.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The sun _____ in the east.
questions.explanation: The sun rises (intransitive) in the east.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Look after means?
questions.explanation: Look after = take care of.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is _____ honest man.
questions.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound, so 'an'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: I _____ this book yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday requires simple past: read.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The cat jumped _____ the table.
questions.explanation: Movement to a surface uses 'onto'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Active of 'The work was finished by him' is?
questions.explanation: Past simple passive → past simple active.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'Rapid' is closest in meaning to?
questions.explanation: Rapid means fast or quick.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Neither of the two brothers were present. Error?
questions.explanation: 'Neither' takes a singular verb: was.
